mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.barcode, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.specification, p.unit, p.purchase_price, p.selling_price, p.quantity, p.min_stock, p.description, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time

sql.if: AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.barcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_sku ps WHERE ps.product_id = p.id AND ( ps.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR (ps.barcode IS NOT NULL AND ps.barcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR ps.specification LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) )

mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT
FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.barcode = #{barcode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, barcode, category_id, specification, unit, purchase_price, selling_price, quantity, min_stock, description, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{barcode}, #{categoryId}, #{specification}, #{unit}, #{purchasePrice}, #{sellingPrice}, #{quantity}, #{minStock}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
